faq.q: Which public schools are on Sumas Prairie itself?
faq.a: Two SD34 schools, confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file: Semá:th Elementary School at 36321 Vye Rd and Barrowtown Elementary at 5137 Tolmie Rd. Catchments are address-based and no locator run for a Sumas Prairie address is on record in this program, so confirm the exact address with the district (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What is being done about Sumas Prairie flooding?
faq.a: The Sumas River Watershed Flood Mitigation Planning Initiative — the Province, three First Nations (Semá:th, Máthxwi, Leq'á:mel) and the Cities of Abbotsford and Chilliwack — was signed in April 2023 after the November 2021 floods; the Province has provided approximately $220 million for Abbotsford and Sumas Prairie since 2021, including $76.6 million for Barrowtown Pump Station upgrades, plus $3.3 million for the initiative's design and assessment work.

faq.q: Can a second dwelling be built on a Sumas Prairie farm parcel?
faq.a: Where the parcel is in the ALR, the ALC frame is one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² of floor area, a secondary suite only within the principal residence, and at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (parcels of 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (parcels over 40 ha); the City's suite cap (less than 50% of the principal unit) and coach/garden cap (15% of the lot to 100 m²) sit alongside it, and the parcel's ALR status and zone must be confirmed first.

faq.q: When are Abbotsford property taxes due, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: For 2026, City of Abbotsford property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a first 5% penalty on July 3, 2026 and a second 5% penalty on September 16, 2026.
